propositions: All three Ubuntu Python cells (3.11, 3.12, 3.13) independently enable pytest-cov and enforce the same repository-wide fail-under floor, creating duplicate coverage tracing without distinct verdicts since production code has no version-conditional branches.
Coverage instrumentation adds ~34 wall seconds of runner occupancy per cell as measured by A-B-B-A-A-B experiment (median A=511.16s with coverage, median B=477.16s without coverage).

Ubuntu Python 3.13 should be designated the primary coverage cell (paired with sole macOS cell for newest stable interpreter) while Python 3.11 and 3.12 remain behavioral-compatibility legs without instrumentation.

Workflow contract must enforce that only Ubuntu Python 3.13 receives coverage flags and all other three matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11, Ubuntu 3.12, macOS 3.13) receive neither, while all cells retain both default and integration pytest tiers.

Django, NumPy, and SciPy OSS projects all selectively collect coverage on primary or dedicated configurations while broader compatibility jobs run uninstrumented, establishing consensus precedent for the optimization.
